task.title: Package and validate the fresh 0.1.29 artifact containing the awkit-44eu UI design
task.objective: Produce a genuinely fresh portable executable and per-user installer from source 665fa08 (which contains the awkit-44eu UI design-system commits de8772c/e816373/03a590f/75b418c), following the documented retry path for the already-committed 0.1.29 version; capture binding provenance (treeDirty false, exact source SHA, artifact size/SHA-256); pass verify:packaged-validation inside its freshness window; launch the exact new executable via packaged-runtime and packaged-walkthrough; visually validate the new design in light AND dark from the packaged artifact; mark all prior artifacts STALE; reconcile project state; commit and push normally.

compatibility: Do not modify renderer/product source unless the packaged artifact exposes a genuine defect.
Do not bump the version: the committed 0.1.29 retry path (npm run package:portable / package:installer) is the documented procedure.
All prior dist artifacts are STALE (provenance source 13eb9eb predates the UI commits) and must never be validated as the fresh artifact.
offline: Packaging stays offline; no dependency changes; signing key handling follows verify:release-key-custody.

acceptance.description: A portable executable and per-user installer are generated during this task from clean source 665fa08, with provenance recording treeDirty false, the exact source SHA, and artifact filename/size/SHA-256 matching disk.

verify:packaged-validation fully passes inside its freshness window (including ASAR renderer identity, asset byte parity, Hologram token propagation, source ancestry and executable binding); the exact new executable launches with appMode=packaged (packaged-runtime, packaged-walkthrough).

The new design is visually confirmed from the packaged artifact in light AND dark across representative major surfaces, including the awkit-44eu work (token spine, chart series theme switch, Sessions status pill, migrated Reports colors, admin modal backdrop, window controls, recorder states, monospace usage, dead-CSS removal causing no live-screen regressions).
awkit-ampd closed and exported, project state reconciled (ledger unchanged unless a real ledger case moved), roadmap Sources agree, work committed to main and pushed normally, worktree clean.
